title: Memento Pattern for State Snapshot and Restoration
title_es: Patrón Memento para Snapshots y Restauración de Estado
description: Companion code for the Memento pattern: opaque snapshots with an Originator/Caretaker split — a text editor undo stack, a game checkpoint system, and a bounded multi-step form wizard, runnable with Node type stripping.
description_es: Código companion del patrón Memento: snapshots opacos con separación Originator/Caretaker — pila de undo de editor de texto, sistema de checkpoints de juego y wizard de formulario acotado, ejecutable con type stripping de Node.
